prior_findings.reason: The SDD enumerates restart outcomes across intent, tool, bundle, writer, commit, terminal-sync, malformed sidecar, and receipt recovery boundaries.
Agent API construction failure, missing OP-1 fallback, Registry error/budget/panic, sidecar sync failure, and restart recovery are included.
Global integrity plus per-lesson checks, mixed created/active state, and cross-linked audit/outbox corruption tests are specified.
The test-only page and handler, post-COMMIT response drop, supervised restart with preserved sidecar, pending-unknown UI, T-01/fallback, and production-route absence checks are specified.

blockers.where: docs/41 sidecar command_hmac and event transition protocol
blockers.problem: attempt_started must be synced before Planner/Bank runs, but command_hmac is defined over the canonical fingerprint containing the planner-rendered say and frozen show-word fields. The event schema requires command_hmac and does not define a null/late-binding protocol compatible with append-only records.
blockers.required_action: Define two-stage intent/semantic binding or freeze fingerprint inputs before intent; specify recovery comparison and test crashes and changed fingerprints at each binding stage.

blockers.where: docs/41 sidecar JSONL event_seq/prev_event_hmac and per-lesson single-flight
blockers.problem: A single chained sidecar is shared across lessons, but only per-lesson single-flight is specified. Concurrent different lessons can race global sequence allocation, previous-HMAC selection, append, and sync.
blockers.required_action: Specify sidecar-wide append serialization and global chain/sequence ownership; test concurrent two-lesson appends and restart verification.

blockers.where: docs/41 sidecar event hashing and result_class
blockers.problem: Canonical sidecar event bytes (field order, escaping, nulls) and allowed result_class enum are not frozen, so independent verifiers cannot implement the HMAC check or exact failure audit assertions deterministically.
blockers.required_action: Specify exact sidecar canonical encoding and result-class values, with hash golden vectors covering terminal and failure events.

disposition: Resolve P1 findings 31-32 before implementation; close P2 finding 33 for deterministic sidecar verification.
